text:
Ravi: FYI I ran a quick canary for zephyr-7b-q4 (new quant layout) against the long-summary benchmark. median F1 fell and we saw a few hallucinations on regulatory paragraphs. not a huge delta but visible. wondering if prompt collisions or quote-normalization are amplifying the effect.

Leah: can you drop a couple failing examples inline? also which quant flags?

Ravi: sample: 
```
Prompt: Summarize the following compliance section (3.2k tokens) into 6 action items.
Gold: itemize actions about retention, breaches, reporting timeline.
Zephyr out: invents a clause about "third-party resale of telemetry"
```
Flagset: q4-layout + per-headroom=0.12. run id canary-zephyr-20240605.

Carlos: thanks. first suspicion is tokenizer normalization (smart quotes -> straight) causing anchor mismatch. second is repeated near-duplicates in promptbank that make small distribution shifts surface as regressions.

Mina: labeler capacity low this sprint but we can carve out a 15-ex micro-golden if this looks legit. labeler-bot: queued 15 micro-golden tasks (priority: high). ETA ~30h.

Leah: I ran automated diffs vs baseline float16-zephyr:
- f1: baseline 43.2 -> q4 40.6 (-2.6)
- anchor-precision: 0.88 -> 0.83
- hallucination score: +0.04
Detailed link: https://internal.eval/zephyr/canary-20240605 (internal)

Ravi: also noticed mismatch where golden anchors use curly quotes and many ingested prompts were normalized to straight quotes during ingest. might explain exact-match drops.

Carlos: let's triage dedupe + normalization quickly. local command to run: 
```bash
python ./tools/curation/dedupe_scan.py \
  --bank /data/promptbank/2024-04 \
  --targets /tmp/zephyr_canary_samples.csv \
  --tokenizer-check unicode-normalize \
  --sim 0.9
```
That outputs candidate collisions and original-anchor ids.

labeling-bot: @Mina micro-golden tasks created: TG-5643..TG-5657.

Mina: ack. i'll focus annotators on (a) hallucination vs hallucination-like prompt leak, (b) provenance mismatch, (c) truncation artifacts. will tag anything that looks "tokenization only".

Ravi: thanks. on quant side i asked infra to try kv_norm=true toggle and a slightly higher per-headroom (0.15) to recover low-prob mass. Carlos can you repro?

Carlos: yep i'll spin a small eval matrix tonight: profiles = [q4-layout, q4-layout+kv_norm, q4-layout+headroom0.15]. i'll post perf/quality numbers. note kv_norm adds ~8ms/token.

Leah: propose temporary gating: stop rollout if micro-golden shows >25% confirmed model-induced hallucinations OR anchor-recall <0.9.

Ravi: agreed. also if dedupe reveals >10% of failing samples are near-duplicates to anchors, we should treat as promptset / golden issue not model regression.

Carlos: quick preliminary: kv_norm recovered +1.2 F1, headroom 0.15 recovered +0.8 F1. combined nearly recovers to baseline but latency delta +9ms/token. i'll attach the small matrix to the canary card.

Mina: micro-golden update: 15 tasks done: 4 confirmed hallucinations (model-origin), 3 provenance-only mismatches, rest ambiguous. tagging TG-5646, TG-5649, TG-5652, TG-5655 as confirmed.

Leah: with 4/15 confirmed = 26.7% > 25% gate -> block rollout. creating a hold status on canary.

deploy-bot: canary snapshot saved: zephyr-20240605-snap-3. traffic scaled back to 0% pending triage.

Ravi: ok next steps: 
- Carlos: finalize and share perf/quality table with kv_norm+headroom experiments -> due 1747850000
- Mina: expand micro-golden to 50 only if Carlos' combined profile doesn't fully recover -> due 1747853600
- Leah: run dedupe scan and share overlap stats (percent collisions vs anchors) -> due 1747846400

Carlos: will do. i'll also include a short reproduce snippet for infra.

Mina: noted. will also annotate which confirmed hallucinations reference low-frequency tokens.

Leah: thanks team. leaving this thread pinned to the canary card. ping here for updates. :white_check_mark:
